name: CUGUV
description: A large-scale benchmark dataset for mapping urban villages with deep learning models from remote sensing data.
evaluation_method: mIoU / AP (mean Intersection-over-Union for segmentation; AP/mAP for detection; accuracy for classification)
reputation: A recent large-scale remote-sensing dataset with growing interest in the geospatial community but not yet as widely used as major benchmarks like SpaceNet.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on remote sensing; large-scale but label noise and geospatial overlap can introduce evaluation artefacts; reported metrics depend on task type (segmentation vs detection vs classification).
